description_en: Generates an analysis for solving a problem
kebab_example:
aliyun aimath gen-analysis --exercise-content '{"answer":"等腰直角","content":{"description":"已知$|m-\sqrt{2}|+\sqrt{n-2}+(p-\sqrt{2})^{2}=0$，则以m、n、p为三边长的三角形是（）三角形"},"solution":{"description":"解：根据题意得，$m-\sqrt{2}=0, n-2=0, p-\sqrt{2}=0$，
解得，$m=\sqrt{2},  n=2, p=\sqrt{2}$, 
$\therefore m=p$，
 又$\because \sqrt{2}^{2}+\sqrt{2}^{2}=2^{2}=4$, 
 即 $m^{2}+p^{2}=n^{2}$，
$\therefore 以m、n、p为三边长的三角形是等腰直角三角形$．
故答案为：等腰直角．"}}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenAnalysis
